hypothesis: After identical ex-ante portfolio risk controls, 12-1 Market+Size+Value factor-residual momentum contains incremental cross-sectional information beyond 12-1 raw momentum.

data.sector_policy: Undated metadata sectors are prohibited from the primary historical factor model
data.remaining_source_blocker: Terminal/delisting economics must be documented or given an explicit conservative policy before inferential evaluation

factor_model.value: cross-sectional winsorized z-score of log(1/price_to_book); non-positive/missing book-to-price receives neutral score 0 after centering
factor_model.momentum_factor: excluded because momentum is the signal under test
factor_model.sector_factor: excluded because audited RW metadata is undated
factor_model.exposure_information_lag: one prior trading observation per ticker

primary_signal: 12-1 residual momentum standardized by pooled daily residual volatility over the formation window
secondary_signal: 6-1 residual momentum standardized by pooled daily residual volatility over the formation window
portfolio_comparison: raw and residual arms receive identical ex-ante beta/gross/net/liquidity/volatility controls; no hindsight sector constraint is permitted
primary_statistic: net spanning-regression alpha of residual arm conditional on raw arm
mechanism_statistic: paired cross-sectional IC difference: residual minus raw

inference.trial_accounting: two registered momentum specifications; DSR/multiple-testing adjustment required

precommitted_outcomes.A: alpha <= 0: stop residual momentum as an alpha transformation
precommitted_outcomes.B: alpha > 0 and delta Sharpe > 0: residual momentum may replace raw momentum
precommitted_outcomes.C: alpha > 0 and delta Sharpe < 0: keep raw core; allocate 25% of portfolio risk budget to incremental FactorStrip sleeve
precommitted_outcomes.D: alpha <= 0 and delta Sharpe > 0: portfolio engineering only; do not claim new alpha

holdout_rule: Do not run inferential alpha/Sharpe/IC evaluation on the clean PIT dataset until this design is formally registered in EdgeLab.
